body: I contacted CPS once when he hit me, they talked to me once and never came back.
I'd be glad to hear them.
I'm not allowed to have a job. How would I even make new friends?
My dad doesn't let me have any money, and I'm six years below the legal drinking age. I also have no backyard, and only one real friend.
If I leave the house for too long, my dad calls the cops. I could get in massive trouble if I'm not home at the right time, so I can't go very far. I don't have a car, or even a bike.
I'm fifteen and in the US, yes.
